_meta.status: DRAFT — general descriptions for the app; review against BRRI/DAE material before launch. No chemical doses are written by us.
_meta.disclaimer_en: This is a preliminary screening, not a definitive expert verdict. Ask your Upazila agriculture officer or call 16123 before using any chemical.

healthy.meaning_en: The leaf looks healthy. No clear disease sign was found.
prevention_en: Use balanced fertiliser; avoid excess urea.

blast.meaning_en: A fungal disease that can attack leaves, nodes and panicles and spreads quickly.
symptoms_en: Grey or whitish centre with a brown border
blast.favourable_conditions_en: Cool nights, warm days, relative humidity above 90%, cloudy weather (BAMIS); excess nitrogen increases risk.

brown_spot.meaning_en: A fungal disease, worse on nutrient-poor soil and from infected seed.
symptoms_en: Small round to oval brown spots
brown_spot.favourable_conditions_en: 28–30 °C, high humidity, cloudy weather (BAMIS); poor soil fertility and drought stress.
prevention_en: Avoid letting the field dry out completely

leaf_smut.meaning_en: A fungal disease, usually of minor importance, that weakens leaves.
symptoms_en: Small, slightly raised black spots or streaks

tungro.scientific_name: Rice tungro bacilliform virus + Rice tungro spherical virus; vector: green leafhopper (Nephotettix spp.)
tungro.meaning_en: A virus disease spread by the green leafhopper.
symptoms_en: Yellow to orange-yellow leaves starting from the tip
Patches of yellow plants in the field

sheath_blight.meaning_en: A fungal disease that starts on the sheath near the water line and moves up.
symptoms_en: Oval grey-green lesions with brown margins on the sheath
Lesions merge into a snakeskin pattern
sheath_blight.favourable_conditions_en: 28–32 °C, high humidity, cloudy weather (BAMIS); dense canopy and excess nitrogen.
prevention_en: Drain the field for a few days

not_sure.meaning_en: The model is not confident enough. Saying 'not sure' is safer than a wrong answer.
not_sure.what_to_do_now_en: Retake a close, well-lit photo of only the affected leaf. If still unsure, call 16123 (Krishi Call Centre).
